response.reason: The implementation uses a standard libm-style minimax polynomial (accurate to well below 1e-6 on |x|<=1) with a logarithmic branch above 1, handles subnormals, large finite FP16 values, and sign correctly (signed zeros equivalent), and masks out-of-range lanes; the FP32 computation error is far below the 1e-6 absolute tolerance across the finite FP16 domain.
